title: Integrate liquid cross-system couplings into the single-step solve
requires: A physical supported GPU, shared Slang build toolchain and public-API test harness
scope: Move existing liquid-liquid, liquid-rigid and liquid-deformable/smoke operators to the shared snapshot and one same-epoch advance. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-REALTIME-60HZ.md; preserve legacy-profile evidence and do not expand advertised interaction modes.
acceptance: Reuse one particle/geometry hierarchy for self and cross-population queries, with no per-pair sorts or time subdivision.
Independent cases check equal-material split-versus-combined populations where valid, balanced exchange, containment, material identity and three-plus-family interactions within the new envelope.
Test sources/outflow, endpoint replacement, differing supported material parameters and bounded overflow/recovery; unsupported modes remain unsupported.
Record bounded algebraic iterations, per-operator dispatch budgets and splitting/dissipation changes; no double integration or stale endpoint snapshot.
